summary: ST-04 is no longer empty: four children, each carrying exactly one of the parent's four criteria verbatim (union covers AC-enc-beats, AC-enc-story, AC-enc-reactions, AC-enc-puzzles; each criterion in exactly one child) and each delivering one independently testable behavior across at most three changed responsibilities (trigger system, world content data, headless scenario tests). Dependency order is valid and justified: WI-04a/b/d are parallel with that parallelism stated explicitly in the story; WI-04c depends on WI-04a and WI-04d because its flag gates read their completion story flags and its fresh-save scenarios must physically hit those milestones; the story-level ST-03 dependency covers the stable roster ids. Every parent criterion has a named final proof owner (WI-04a beats, WI-04b story budget, WI-04c reactions, WI-04d puzzles), and the cross-child proof that beats fire 'inside live gameplay' is owned solely by WI-04a's browser check with an explicit no-reassertion note. Leaf handoffs are fresh-session ready: concrete file pointers (src/world/triggers.ts, src/world/worldData.ts, src/sim/scenario.ts), spoiler discipline (private reveal map referenced by id only, never quoted), bounded non-goals (no creature-controller or AI changes, no MacGuffin/ending content, no balance tuning, no new puzzle UI), and explicit escalation routes for falsified assumptions (WI-04a reports new-creature-behavior needs as defects; WI-04d routes new sim-rule needs through fix planning; WI-04b treats the section 38 budget as the hard gate). Minor non-blocking notes: the story frontmatter lists 'creature simulation' though no child changes it (beats read ST-03 states and reuse existing moveBackgroundCreature - over-listed union, not hidden scope; child inventories are accurate), and WI-04b reads beat/puzzle flag names from the parallel siblings for optional radio gating, which is defensible because flag ids derive deterministically from the shared reveal map and any drift surfaces in WI-04c's post-milestone scenarios.
